description: A tall insect warrior built like a praying mantis fills the square, seen from the chest up and slightly to the viewer's left. Its body is bright green with dark shading, its head long and angular with large glowing yellow-orange compound eyes and two long thin antennae sweeping back. It has more than two arms: one grips a long pole weapon whose pale, many-pronged blade rises at the upper right, and others work a white, star-like bladed throwing weapon in front of its body. The background is flat deep red inside a thin blue border. The mood is alien and dangerous. Frame 1: the arms hold the bladed weapon low at the right, held long. Frame 2: the arm draws back toward the chest, a flash. Frame 3: the arm whips forward across the face, a flash. Frame 4: the weapon blurs into a white whirling streak, briefest. Frame 5: a bright white burst of spinning blades fills the space before its face, held a little longer. The loop reads as a long poised pause, then a sudden, whirling throw.
title: Mantis warrior hurling a blade
